info.description:
# Maham Customer API (v1)

**Base URL**: `{{base_url}}` (local: `http://maham.test/api/v1`)

## Headers on every request
- `Accept: application/json`
- `Accept-Language: ar` or `en` (messages, validation errors and content come back in this language)
- `Authorization: Bearer {token}` on protected endpoints

## Response format
Success: `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": {...} }`

Error: `{ "success": false, "message": "first error to show the user", "errors": { "field": ["..."] } }`

Status codes: 200 OK, 401 not logged in / token expired, 403 forbidden, 404 not found, 422 validation error, 429 too many requests / OTP resend too soon, 503 SMS provider down.

## Registration flow & next_step
Every auth response contains `next_step`. Open the screen for that value:
- `verify_phone` -> Phone number screen (Google/Apple users: use **Phone (social users)** endpoints)
- `personal_details` -> Tell us about yourself
- `credentials` -> Secure your account (email + password)
- `verify_email` -> Verify Email OTP sheet
- `address` -> Where should we find you?
- `profile_image` -> Add a profile photo
- `completed` -> Home
- `guest` -> Home in guest mode

If the user closes the app mid sign-up, call `GET /auth/me` on launch and open the `next_step` screen.

## Phone numbers
Send any Saudi format: `0512345678`, `512345678` or `+966512345678`. The API returns `phone` as `512345678` and `phone_country_code` as `+966`.

## OTP
**Demo account (local)**: demo@maham.sa / Demo1234 / phone 0500000001.

4 digits, valid 5 minutes, resend after 60 seconds (values also returned by `/app/config`). **On the local/staging server the OTP is always `1234`.**

request.description:
Call on the Splash screen.

- `data.update`: `force` = block the app and open `versions.{platform}.store_url`; `optional` = show "update available"; `none` = continue.
- `data.maintenance_mode`: show maintenance screen when true.
- `data.languages`: options for the Choose language screen (`direction` rtl/ltr).
- `data.otp`: OTP length and timers.

The chosen language is kept on the device and sent as `Accept-Language` on every request.

item.description:
# Request Service (customer)

Screens: **Service Details** -> "Request service" -> **1. Add Address** -> **2. Select Date and Time** -> **3. What do you need done?** -> **4. Add photos (optional)** -> **Confirm Request** -> "Submit Request" -> **Request Submitted** popup -> **My Requests**.

## How the app should do it
1. Call `GET /service-requests/options` once to fill the **Flexibility** dropdown (labels come in the user's language).
2. Steps 1-4 are only forms on the phone. Keep the values locally; validate on the phone and press **Next**.
   - Step 1 prefill: use `user.default_address` from `GET /auth/me` (city, district, street, postal code) and send its id as `address_id`.
   - Cities: `GET /cities`, districts: `GET /cities/{id}/districts`.
3. **Confirm Request** screen is built from the local values. The pencil icons just go back to that step.
4. **Submit Request** -> `POST /service-requests` (multipart/form-data) with everything. On 201 show the popup with `message`. On 422 show `message` and go back to the step that has the error field.
5. **My Requests** button -> `GET /service-requests`.

## Images
All images in the API (service icons, service cover, onboarding, avatar, request photos) are stored with Spatie Media Library and returned as full URLs, e.g. `http://maham.test/storage/15/ac-photo-1.jpg`.

## Arabic
Send `Accept-Language: ar` to get messages, validation errors, service names, `status_label`, `flexibility_label`, `preferred_date_label` and `preferred_time_label` in Arabic. The saved values (`flexibility`, `status`, `preferred_date` ...) never change with the language.

request.description:
**Confirm and Pay** on the Payments sheet. On success open **Booking Confirmed** with the returned booking.

**Body**
- `payment_method` (required): `card` | `apple_pay`.
- `payment_id`: the payment id returned by the Moyasar Flutter SDK after the customer paid. Required on live (`gateway = moyasar`), optional on local/staging (`gateway = fake`, payment always succeeds). Each id can be used only once.

**Live flow**: Offer details -> Moyasar SDK (publishable_key, amount_halalas, SAR) -> SDK returns `id` with status `paid` -> send it here. The server checks with Moyasar that it is paid, for the same amount, in SAR.

**What happens**: offer -> accepted, other offers -> rejected, request -> accepted (Closed tab, "Offer Accepted"), booking + payment created, "Payment successful" notification added (with `booking_id`).

**Errors (422)**: `errors.offer` = offer no longer available (already accepted / request cancelled); `errors.payment_id` = payment not completed; `errors.payment_method` = invalid method. 403 for guests.

**Response `data`** (Booking Confirmed): `reference`, `receipt_number`, `service`, `provider`, `scheduled_date_label`, `scheduled_time_label`, `address`, `service_price`, `total_amount`, `payment_method_label`, `receipt_url` ("Download Receipt": open in the browser). "View Bookings" -> Bookings tab (next module).

The booking id is saved to `{{booking_id}}` and the receipt link to `{{receipt_url}}`.

**Live body example**:
```json
{
    "payment_method": "card",
    "payment_id": "760878ec-d1d3-5f72-9056-191683f55872"
}
```

# My Requests, Offers & Booking (customer)

Screens: **My Requests** (Open / Closed) -> **Request Details** -> **Offers Received** -> **Offer Details** -> **Accept Offer** (Confirm Details -> Payments) -> **Booking Confirmed**. Also **Provider Details** and **Customers Reviews**.

## My Requests cards (use GET /service-requests from folder 8)
Badge on each card:
- `status = open` and `offers_count = 0` -> "Awaiting Offers" (buttons: View Details, Cancel Request)
- `status = open` and `offers_count > 0` -> "Offers (n)" (also show **View Offers**)
- `status = accepted` -> "Offer Accepted" (Closed tab)
- `status = cancelled` -> "Cancelled" (Closed tab)

**Request Again** (Closed tab): no new API. Open the Request Service steps pre-filled with the old request's values (service, address, description, budget, flexibility), let the user pick a new date, then call **Submit request**.

## Demo data (local)
`php artisan db:seed --class=DemoMarketplaceSeeder` adds 2 providers (Mohammed Al-Rashidi id 4 with 8 reviews, Khalid Al-Otaibi id 5) and requests for demo@maham.sa: one awaiting offers, one with 2 offers, one accepted with a booking, one cancelled.

## Payments
Local / staging use `PAYMENT_DRIVER=fake` (every payment succeeds, `payment_id` optional). Live uses Moyasar: the app charges with the Moyasar Flutter SDK and sends the returned payment id to **Accept offer**.

item.description:
# My Bookings, Booking Details & Rate Provider (customer)

Screens: **My Bookings** (Confirmed / InProgress / Completed tabs) -> **View Details** -> **Booking Details** -> **View Receipt** / **Chat** / **Rate the Service Provider** -> **Review Submitted** popup.

## Booking Details timeline
`timeline` always has 3 steps in this order: `confirmed` (Booking Confirmed), `in_progress` (Work InProgress), `completed` (Completed).
- `is_done = true` -> the step happened: show `date_label` and the white box with `message`.
- `is_done = false` -> grey icon, no date and no box (`message` is null).
- `is_current = true` -> the latest step that happened (orange icon in the design).
- Under **Booking Confirmed** show **View Receipt** (opens the receipt popup from the booking fields; **Download Receipt** opens `receipt_url`).
- Under **Completed**: if `can_review = true` show **Rate the Service Provider**; if `review` is not null show "You rate the Provider" with `review.rating` stars and `review.comment`.

The status is changed by the provider (folder **12. Provider - Start / Complete Work**): confirmed -> in_progress -> completed. The customer gets the `work_started` / `work_completed` notifications with `booking_id`.

## Demo data (local)
`php artisan db:seed --class=DemoBookingSeeder` adds for demo@maham.sa: 1 booking in progress, 1 completed booking waiting for a rating, 1 completed booking already rated, and a chat with Mohammed Al-Rashidi.

item.description:
# Chat (customer <-> provider)

Screens: **Chat** tab (list) -> tap a row -> **Chat (Single)**. The **Chat** button on a booking card or on Booking Details calls **Open chat from booking**.

There is one chat per customer/provider pair (several bookings with the same provider share the chat).

## Getting new messages
No live socket yet. While the chat screen is open, call **Chat messages (new only)** every 5 seconds with `after_id` = id of the newest message on screen, and add the returned messages to the bottom.

## Message types
- `text`: show `body`.
- `image`: show the photo `image_url` (and `body` as a caption if not null).
- `system`: safety warning from Maham. Show it in the middle of the chat (no avatar, `sender` is null).

Sender row: if `is_mine = true` show "Me", otherwise `sender.name`. Date next to the name: `created_at_label`.

## Chat safety
Phone numbers in a message are replaced with `**********`. When a message has a phone number or words like "cash", "transfer", "my number", "whatsapp" (English or Arabic), a `system` warning is added right after it.

item.description:
# Provider: Start Work / Complete Work

Moves a booking along the customer's **Booking Details** timeline:

`confirmed` --**Start work**--> `in_progress` --**Complete work**--> `completed` --> customer can **Rate provider** (folder 10).

Steps cannot be skipped or repeated (422 `errors.booking`). Only the booking's provider can call them (404 otherwise).

## Try it (local)
1. **Provider login** (saves `{{provider_token}}`).
2. **Start work** on `{{booking_id}}`.
3. As the customer, open **Booking details** -> step 2 is done.
4. **Complete work**.
5. As the customer, **Rate provider** on `{{booking_id}}`.

This changes the demo booking. Run `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` to reset the demo data.

item.name: 14. Provider - Become a Service Provider
item.description:
# Become a Service Provider (Registration)

Onboarding 14 -> **Select Service** -> **Choose Service Area** -> **Business Details** -> **Upload Business Logo** -> **Application Submitted!**

Any fully registered customer can apply with their normal `{{token}}` (guests and users who did not finish sign-up get 403).

Each **Next** saves its step on the server, so if the user closes the app, call **Get application** and open `next_step`.

After **Submit** the application is `pending` and locked (422 `errors.application`). The admin team reviews it (24-48 hours):
- approved -> `status = approved`, the user becomes a provider (`is_provider = true`)
- rejected -> `status = rejected` with `rejection_reason`; the user can edit and submit again

## Try it (local)
1. **Login** as the demo customer (folder 3).
2. Run the requests of this folder in order.

This changes the demo customer. Run `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` to reset the demo data.

**Upload Business Logo** -> Submit details. multipart/form-data with `logo` (jpg/png/webp, max 5 MB). A new logo replaces the old one.

Sends the application for admin review: `status = pending`, `next_step = submitted`. Show the **Application Submitted!** screen.

Steps 1-3 must be done first (422 `errors.next_step` names the missing step). A rejected application can be submitted again.

The user becomes a provider only after an admin approves it.

Response `data` = the application (same shape on every endpoint of this folder, see **Get application**).
